name: Bigamy
overview: The Bible records instances of bigamy, such as Lamech taking two wives, Adah and Zillah, illustrating that polygamous relationships existed in early biblical history. However, Scripture also warns against multiplying wives, as seen in Deuteronomy 17:17, which cautions against having many wives to prevent the heart from turning away from God. The New Testament emphasizes the original design of marriage as a union between one man and one woman, joined as one flesh, underscoring the ideal of monogamous marriage.
